domains.title: Domains
domains.description: One per line: example.com, www.example.com or a full URL (only the domain is used). Each homepage is fetched once.

requireAll.title: Must use all of
requireAll.description: Keep only sites using every one of these, e.g. "Shopify", "Klaviyo". Names are forgiving: "woocommerce", "google analytics", "GA4" all work.

requireAny.title: Must use at least one of
requireAny.description: Keep only sites using at least one of these, e.g. "Shopify", "WooCommerce", "BigCommerce".

exclude.title: Must not use
exclude.description: Drop sites using any of these. Example: require Shopify and exclude Klaviyo to find stores without Klaviyo.

enrich.title: Add contact details
enrich.description: For matching sites, read the contact and about pages (at most 2 extra pages) for published emails, phone numbers and social profiles.

includeNonMatches.title: Include non-matching sites
includeNonMatches.description: Also output sites that didn't match, or couldn't be loaded, with the reason. These rows are free.

maxItems.title: Max matching sites
maxItems.description: Stop once this many matching sites have been found.
